subject: DataWave evaluation: success metrics, ramp plan, and weekly nudges
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samir Qureshi <samir@datawave.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@datawave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: DataWave evaluation: success metrics, ramp plan, and weekly nudges

Samir / Laura — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the eval moving this week.

Summary of what we heard from your side
- Goal: validate embedding relevance + 1s latency for the search flow across 10k queries/day (initial slice).
- Success metrics:
  - Embedding quality: precision@10 >= 0.68 on your seed prompt set (we'll use the 2000-test queries you shared).
  - Latency: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 250ms on the test harness with 8 concurrent clients.
  - Cost target: marginal per-1000 tokens cost <= $1.50 (approx).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) — initial 2-week sprint
1) DataWave: share technical contact for infra/testing (who will provide sample queries and run harness).
   - Samir: can you confirm by EOD Monday?
2) Redwood: provision trial endpoint, baseline model (rw-embed-compact-v1), and pre-configured test harness. Owner: Priyom. Target: Wed 2/17.
3) Onboarding & config: 60-min kickoff to walk through test harness and seeds. Owner: Marissa. Target: Thurs 2/18.
4) Security/compliance: we attached the SOC2 request sheet for your reviewer. We can provide the SOC2 summary and infra diagram after initial NDA (if needed).

Attachments included: DataWave-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), Redwood-SOC2-request.pdf (security checklist).

Open questions / decisions needed from DataWave
- Who is the technical point of contact for running the harness? (name + email)
- Are there any specific IP or redaction rules for the sample data?

Next steps
- Samir: reply with TPOC and confirm the seeds/harness timeline by EOD Mon (2/15).
- Priyom: will provision test endpoint and post access details here once ready.
- Marissa: will propose 2 slots for the kickoff once Samir confirms TPOC.

Thanks — I want to keep this lightweight but specific so we hit measurable milestones.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
 dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Samir Qureshi <samir@datawave.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@datawave.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DataWave evaluation: success metrics, ramp plan, and weekly nudges

Thanks Dylan — good summary. Quick answers:
- Technical contact: Alex Ruiz <alex@datawave.ai> (he owns the infra and will run the harness).
- No special IP rules for this initial slice; we'll mask any PII before sending.
- Security reviewer: Laura will own the SOC2 checklist — attaching the list she prefers (see stub).

We can do kickoff Thurs 2/18 at 11:00 PT — that works for Alex and Laura.

One small change to success metrics: we want to see precision@10 >= 0.70 if achievable; otherwise we keep 0.68 as minimum. Also, can you confirm how you compute p99 (client-side vs. server-side)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Samir
Samir Qureshi
Head of Data Science, DataWave
 samir@datawave.ai | +1 (206) 555-0147
[Attachment: DataWave-security-review-stub.pdf (security reviewer checklist)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samir Qureshi <samir@datawave.ai>, Alex Ruiz <alex@datawave.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@datawave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DataWave evaluation: success metrics, ramp plan, and weekly nudges

Great — thanks for the fast reply and for adding Alex and Laura. A couple follow-ups and owners below.

Owners & next actions (updated)
- Priyom Das (Priyom): provision trial endpoint + baseline model (rw-embed-compact-v1). Deliverable: endpoint URL + API key. Target: Wed 2/17 COB.
- Marissa Cole (Marissa): run 60-min kickoff with your team (Alex + Laura) and review harness. Proposed: Thu 2/18 11:00 PT (Samir confirmed). Marissa will send calendar invite.
- Rishi Malhotra (Rishi): will join the kickoff to overview quantization options and latency tuning.

Technical clarifications
- p99 definition: we'll report server-side p99 (end-to-end from request received by the endpoint to token emitted). For transparency we can also provide client-side numbers if you run the harness.
- Precision metric: we'll compute precision@10 on the seeded test set you provide. We can run both thresholds (0.68 and 0.70) and flag regressions.

Attachments: I uploaded an updated MAP with a proposed gating checklist: DataWave-MAP-v2.xlsx (link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/DataWave/MAP-v2).

If anything changes on your side with the kickoff time please let us know; otherwise we'll proceed with the 2/18 slot.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DataWave evaluation: success metrics, ramp plan, and weekly nudges

Internal note before kickoff — quick checklist for the 2/18 session: 
- Priyom: ensure trial endpoint can accept the 8-concurrent-client harness and that api-key scoped to read-only.
- Rishi: prepare 10-15 slides on latency tuning + quantization tradeoffs (target p95/p99 slides).
- I will draft the kickoff agenda and confirm invite with Alex/Laura (Samir cc'd in external thread).

Also prepared a short troubleshooting playbook for common errors during test harness runs (will attach in calendar invite).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Qureshi <samir@datawave.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Alex Ruiz <alex@datawave.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@datawave.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 13:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DataWave evaluation: success metrics, ramp plan, and weekly nudges

Thanks team — kickoff went well. A couple items from our side after the session:
- We ran the baseline harness and saw median latency ~110ms, p95 ~145ms, p99 ~265ms. Looks close but p99 is slightly above the target.
- For success criteria: we'll accept p99 <= 260ms as a pass for Week 1 if precision@10 >= 0.69. If you can get p99 down to <=250ms by Week 2, we'll consider the latency gate met.
- Security: Laura will follow up with the SOC2 reviewer; she may ask for the infra diagram and access logs for the test endpoint.

Can you send a short weekly status update every Monday with: 1) test harness results (median/p95/p99), 2) precision@10, 3) blocker list and next actions?

On Mon, Feb 15, 2027 at 11:05 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great — thanks for the fast reply and for adding Alex and Laura. A couple follow-ups and owners below.
> 
> Owners & next actions (updated)
> - Priyom Das (Priyom): provision trial endpoint + baseline model (rw-embed-compact-v1). Deliverable: endpoint URL + API key. Target: Wed 2/17 COB.

Will do — will wait for the Monday report and the endpoint access details.

— Samir

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Samir Qureshi <samir@datawave.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@datawave.ai>, Alex Ruiz <alex@datawave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly status & next steps — DataWave evaluation (week 1)

Hi Samir / team — weekly status following your request. Short summary with links and next actions.

This week (baseline run) — highlights
- Endpoint: provisioned and shared (pri-ep-7u3). API key sent to Alex via secure channel.
- Test harness (8 concurrent) results: median 108ms, p95 142ms, p99 258ms.
- Precision@10 on the seed set: 0.695 (we ran both 0.69 and 0.70 thresholds; 0.69 passes).

Blockers / notes
- p99 is 258ms — slightly above the earlier ask. Rishi is running a latency tuning pass (kernel selection + kv-cache tweaks) and expects to reduce p99 by ~10–12ms in the next run.
- Security: Laura asked for access logs and an infra diagram; Rishi will export the logs and Priyom will attach the infra diagram by Monday.

Next actions (owners & ETA)
- Rishi Malhotra: latency tuning pass and follow-up run (ETA Mon 2/22).
- Priyom Das: upload infra diagram + access logs to shared drive (ETA Mon 2/22).
- Marissa Cole: send calendar invites for weekly 30-min syncs (recurring Mondays) and include troubleshooting playbook.

Links & attachments
- MAP: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/DataWave/MAP-v2
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/DW-2027-014
- Attachments: DataWave-MAP-v2.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-request.pdf

If this summary looks right, we'll proceed with the tuning pass and post a short "results + blockers" note next Monday. If you want a quick sync before then we can do a 15-minute check-in.

Thanks — will keep nudging to keep momentum.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
